Recruitment communication: verify before you act.

How to use official information and read GA Digital’s published recruitment notice.

Editorial guide · 7 October 2026 · 3 min read

Read the vacancy notification

Check the organization, role, location, eligibility, closing date and application instructions in the vacancy notice. A listing remaining online does not confirm that applications are open.

Be alert to placement promises

GA Digital’s public notice dated 14 June 2025 states that it does not charge a job-placement fee and is not associated with outside brokers acting independently.

Distinguish fees from joining requirements

A separate joining notice describes a refundable joining security deposit payable by demand draft. Confirm current requirements directly with the company; do not pay an intermediary who promises selection.

Report suspicious approaches

Contact info@gadigital.in using the company’s published contact details. Keep the communication and relevant details available for the company to review.

Confirm engagement-specific requirements directly with our team.
